title: skills: the hooks and i18n skills do not teach a handler-authored hook's `refusals`, the per-code `reasons`, or `params` (#33214)
body:
domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #33641 (#33214). Contract review record 6889389473 (③) requires it filed before ACCEPT.
Business reason: an AI agent that writes business hooks in TypeScript learns from the published skills that a refusal catalogue needs a hand-written sandboxed `body`, with one sentence per code and no params. Once PR #33641 lands, that teaching is wrong, and the agent keeps refusing in English or invents codes.
Reader who acts: `domain:skills`.

## 维护者速读

钩子拒绝目录在 #33214 之后支持 TypeScript 处理器、同码多句（`reasons`）和参数（`params`），但技能文档还说只能写沙箱 JS、一码一句。PR #33641 合并后要同步这两份技能文档。

## Work (after PR #33641 merges)

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, section "Declared refusals (`refusals`)":
  - a handler-authored hook may declare `refusals`;
  - `reasons` sit under a code, and the body throws `{ code, reason }`;
  - `params` are declared names, and a `{{ }}` hole is allowed only over one of them.
- `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`: next to the `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.message` row, add `hooks.HOOK.refusals.CODE.reasons.REASON.message`.

Blocked-by: #33214

## Dedupe

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue skills hook refusals reasons` → none at filing. Related: #33214, PR #33641, #33635 (the same i18n skill, for `sourceLocale`).

⛔ Not a claim. Grading is triage's.
